intended_owner_result: A sample extract must reject an observed output filename substitution, retain any substituted recording during failure cleanup, refuse silent short disk writes, and keep extraction into new or empty directories usable.
findings: Independent QA Cycle11 source R16 reproduced two per-file races in synthetic adversarial checks. Producer added negative regression, before 14/17 exit1, after 17/17 exit0 (normal and Python -O). Original R16 14/14 baseline preserved.
test_scope: Python3.13 Linux real temporary POSIX filesystem. Actual Git main function AST window verified against R16 exact blob, and new 6374-byte window patched identically to source; synthetic archive data and injected rename/symlink/interrupt/short-write. No physical MIDI; no complete-root run.
limits: Inode comparison then unlink is not an atomic unlink-if-matching-inode. Same-user malicious writer swapping between check and unlink, untrusted ancestor directories and post-return modifications remain unsupported. Extract to a private trusted directory. An external actor moving an owner file may remove its original pathname: no tool can guarantee original path if the actor changed it.
required_checks: Repeat registered native 17-case test against full exact Git file, attempt adversarial inode-swap-at-unlink and parent mutations; run affected full-root native CLI/update/backup/controller suites and report scoped failures honestly. Only sole Safe Merge integrates QA-accepted change.
